tree.heading: Designation.—
tree.text: The week beginning on the second Sunday in October is National School Lunch Week.

tree.heading: Proclamation.—
tree.text: The President is requested to issue each year a proclamation calling on the people of the United States to observe National School Lunch Week with appropriate ceremonies and activities.
